title: Light Korean Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir-fry recipe using Korean noodles and a variety of flavors.
instructions: Cook the Korean noodles according to package instructions.
Heat the light oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the kissed garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for another minute.
Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the amazake and stir-fry for another minute.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
